Recipe: Longjaw Mud Snapper

Recipe: Longjaw Mud Snapper is a Common Cooking recipe in the WoW Forever client. Forever changed it from Classic Era. Where it comes from: Sold by 9 vendors (seen in WoW Forever).

  • Item level 15
  • "Teaches you how to cook Longjaw Mud Snapper."
  • Sells to vendors for 1s

Teaches Longjaw Mud Snapper (Cooking 50), which makes Longjaw Mud Snapper.
